lines.en: I stand under one block tall.
And I am a Perfect level.
My four short legs run fast.

lines.zh: 丛林的地面，踩下去满是落叶。
lines.en: The jungle floor is deep with fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 落叶厚，我的脚步几乎没声。
lines.en: The leaves are thick; my steps barely sound.
I walk, following a scent.
Three or four of us come at once.
I keep to the edge of the group.
The grass ahead is pushed apart.
I need somewhere to rest.
This stretch is too large.

lines.zh: 我沿着一条被踩出来的路走。
lines.en: I follow a path that has been trodden flat.
I lie among the tree roots.
A small patch is enough for me.
My tail sweeps the ground.

lines.zh: 锚点的震动，我耳朵很灵。
lines.en: I hear the anchor's tremor quite well.

lines.zh: 风一吹，叶子落到我头上。
lines.en: Wind drops a leaf on my head.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看树上有没有东西。
lines.en: I look up to see what is in the trees.

lines.zh: 这片林子安静得只剩我的呼吸。
lines.en: This forest is quiet but for my breathing.
I was raised on meat.
My belly feels a little empty.
I listen to birds in the trees.
They are too loud.
I open wide and yawn.
My teeth click together.

lines.zh: 我用后爪挠耳朵，痒得厉害。
lines.en: I scratch my ear with a hind claw; it itches.
You are much taller than me.
I raise my head and look at you.

lines.zh: 你身上有别的数码兽的味道。
lines.en: You carry the scent of another Digimon.
I do not much like that smell.

lines.zh: 我是完全体，你可别小看我。
lines.en: I am Perfect level; do not underestimate me.
I am small, and fast.
I know the ground by your feet.
You bend down to look at me.
That is much better for seeing you.
Only this close can I see you clearly.
You ran hard; your throat is raw.
You are looking at my head.

lines.zh: 我头上有角一样的硬块。
lines.en: I have hard ridges on my head like horns.
Those are no true horns.
You reach a finger out.
Under one block tall, and plenty of temper.
I'm small enough to somersault.
And up again at once.
Small, but hard boned.
I pant, something tight in my throat.
And flatten myself down again.
I can still run a few steps.

lines.zh: 抖掉泥，我的爪子又抬起来。
lines.en: I shake off the mud and raise my claws again.
Nothing serious.
I growl once, low.
One tail swing and the dirt flies.
Is that meat in your hand?
Hold it lower for me.
I cannot reach that high.
Just crouch down.

lines.zh: 你手里是肉吗，举低一些给我。
lines.en: Is that meat? Hold it lower for me.
I come forward a little.
You are still holding on.
Then I will just wait.
My patience is good.
Steady your hand and hold it out slowly.
Little Mametyra can't reach that high.
I cannot reach even jumping.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴，我哼了一声。
lines.en: You step on my tail and I grunt.
I dodge very quickly.
I am small and easy to miss.
Look down next time.
My shoulder hits your ankle.
You bumped first.
Short as I am, my teeth aren't.

lines.zh: 你的脚比我整个身子还长。
lines.en: Your foot is longer than my whole body.
I walk along the edge.

lines.zh: 你退开的时候踩到了我的尾巴。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail as you moved back.
Our kind rarely speak of it.

lines.zh: 我连自己的训练师都还没有。
lines.en: I do not even have a tamer.
You ask a little early.

lines.zh: 我们野外来的不兴这个。
lines.en: We wild ones do not bother with it.

lines.zh: 我还没到那一步，爪太近了。
lines.en: I am not there yet; the claws are too close.

lines.zh: 你要是训练师，也许能安排。
lines.en: If you were a tamer, perhaps it could be arranged.
But you are not.

lines.zh: 我们这一群里没有母的。
lines.en: There are no females in this pack.
If you want to hear it: no.

lines.zh: 这件事等我进化以后再说。
lines.en: That waits until I evolve.
An object lies on the ground.
I pick it up in my jaws.
This much is not heavy.
Carrying things is what I do.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，走了好一段路。
lines.en: I carry it in my jaws for a long way.
Too heavy, so I put it down.
It rolled into a root gap.
I dig it out with a claw.

lines.zh: 我把肉叼到树根下藏好。
lines.en: I carry the meat under the roots and stash it.
Perhaps someone will have a use for it.

lines.zh: 你抬起手，我就知道要躲。
lines.en: You raise your arm; I know to dodge.
Then you are no friend.
I drop my body low.
I will use Beast Slash.
You will not see how I strike.
I am small; you will not hit clean.
I lower my forelegs.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，利爪已经张开。
lines.en: I crouch low with my claws already spread.
You did not pull back.
Then I will give it a try.
I shifted a foot first.
That was time given to you.
I slip behind your feet.

lines.zh: 你转身找我的时候我已经换了边。
lines.en: By the time you turn I have moved sides.
The grass hides my shape.
Your eyes keep dropping.
Yes, keep looking like that.

lines.zh: 你的影子一动，我就跟着动。
lines.en: The moment your shadow moves, I move.
Your boots press the grass.
I hear every one.
You cannot walk quickly here.
My tail lifts a little.
That means I am about to strike.

lines.zh: 小暴君的爪子先探出来。
lines.en: The little tyrant's claws reach out first.
Small as I am, my claws arrive first.
Beast Slash cuts in from the side.
You did not expect that.
I turn the moment I land.
I caught your shin.
Then once more.
I bite the hem of your trousers from below.
You will struggle to reach me.
I release and pull back.
You fall back two steps; I do not follow.

lines.zh: 我一爪子拍下去，土飞起来。
lines.en: One claw swipe and the dirt flies.
I give you no room to breathe.

lines.zh: 我从灌木里挤出半个身子。
lines.en: I squeeze halfway out of the bushes.
Leaves still cling to my back.
I have no anchor here.
Let me find somewhere first.
Under the roots will do.
You are staring at me.
That is fine too.

lines.zh: 丛林的光碎在叶子上，我来了。
lines.en: Jungle light breaks through the leaves; I am here.
I stand on a patch of thick moss.

lines.zh: 远处有别的数码兽在叫。
lines.en: Another Digimon calls in the distance.

lines.zh: 它叫了一声，我只当没听见。
lines.en: It called out; I pretend I did not hear.
Now is not the time for talk.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的背，我打了个滚。
lines.en: Fire catches my back and I roll.
I slide off a root.

lines.zh: 水一下盖住我，我拼命刨。
lines.en: Water closes over me; I claw upward.
The blast throws me a long way.
Something sharp is in my leg.

lines.zh: 那光让我的动作慢下来。
lines.en: That light slows my movements.
Hungry, I cannot fight well.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我这不到一格的身子一麻。
lines.en: Lightning falls and this under-a-block body goes numb.
The earth under me is gone.
